subject: Expansion roadmap & MAP kickoff — Q2 renewal + usage review
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Amaya Lopez <amaya.lopez@orchid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Expansion roadmap & MAP kickoff — Q2 renewal + usage review

Amaya / Orchid team —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) in motion so we have alignment on the renewal window, the technical evaluation items, and a concrete upsell path tied to usage goals. High level proposal below — attaching a starter MAP and a usage summary so everyone has the same data.

Quick goals for this kickoff:
- Confirm primary stakeholders and decision owners.
- Validate the evaluation checklist (latency, token cost, end-to-end SLOs, and integration tests).
- Agree on a close target and procurement path.

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (this week): stakeholder introductions + agree MAP deliverables.
- Week 2: technical eval (usage spike test + integration checklist).
- Week 3: finalize terms and procurement worksheet.
- Week 4: sign and schedule expanded capacity (if all checks pass).

Attachments: Orchid_MAP_Q2_renewal.xlsx, usage-summary-feb2026.pdf

Action I'd like from you: please reply with the additional internal stakeholders and any timing constraints for Procurement. If useful, share a preferred time for a 30-min kickoff (I have slots Tue 10–11am and Wed 2–4pm ET).

I’m looping in Marissa from CS to run the eval plan and Karthik from Solutions to own any architecture/quantization questions.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Amaya Lopez <amaya.lopez@orchid.ai>

Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expansion roadmap & MAP kickoff — Q2 renewal + usage review

Sean —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Orchid is keen to get this moving. Quick notes from our side:
- I'll be the executive sponsor for the renewal.
- Please add Darren Shaw from Procurement (cc’d on my reply) — he’ll own contracts and timeline.
- Technical lead on our side will be Priya Ramesh (she's out today; I’ll introduce her in the next thread).

For the kickoff meeting, Tue 10:30am ET works for us if you can do 10:00–11:00. Procurement prefers a two-week review window after the final quote.

Also: two asks for the MAP docs — can you add a short checklist item for data residency and audit logs (SOC 2 evidence we requested earlier)? And we’ll need a clear uplift estimate tied to 2x usage tiers.

Thanks — looping Darren now.

Best,
Amaya Lopez
Director, Platform Partnerships
Orchid Analytics
amaya.lopez@orchid.ai

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expansion roadmap & MAP kickoff — Q2 renewal + usage review

Amaya / team —

Appreciate the quick response. I’ll own the technical evaluation plan and the SOC 2 / audit-log checklist Amaya requested. Karthik, I’ve added you to own the architecture/quantization validation and the synthetic load test.

Proposed eval items (short list):
- Integration test against staging (5 endpoints, smoke tests).
- Peak token-load simulation (we can run a 48-hour window to validate cost/latency at 2x).
- KV-cache/latency regression checks with your average seq lengths.
- SOC2 evidence bundle + retention policy confirmation.

I’m sharing a proposed meeting invite below and attaching the procurement worksheet template we use for renewals.
Attachments: procurement-worksheet.xlsx

Proposed kickoff: Tue 24 Feb 2026, 10:30–11:00am ET — Teams link included in calendar invite (I’ll send shortly).

If there are any special integration constraints (VPC, on-prem routing), please flag them before the kickoff so Karthik can pull in the right infra engineers.

Marissa

Redwood Inference

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Procurement timeline and asks:
- We need the procurement worksheet completed with line-item uplift and a sample SOW by close of week 3 (targeting Fri 13 Mar).
- Please include any pass-through cloud costs and a clear cancellation/exit clause.
- Once we have the final quote, we’ll require 5 business days for legal and PO creation.

Sean — can you confirm whether the uplift pricing in the MAP is an estimated band or a firm quote? If estimated, please note when we’ll receive the final firm quote. Also send the contract worksheet as soon as you have one filled out.

I can take a look at the procurement worksheet attached and will provide comments before the Week 3 deadline.

Head of Procurement

Appreciate the alignment, everyone — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary (agreed):
- Kickoff meeting: Tue 24 Feb 2026, 10:30–11:00am ET (Teams).
- Technical eval: Marissa + Karthik to run staging integration + 48h peak test in Week 2.
- Procurement: Darren to review procurement-worksheet.xlsx; Redwood to provide filled worksheet + firm uplift quote by Fri 13 Mar.
- SOC2 / audit logs: Marissa to compile evidence bundle during evaluation.

Action items:
- Sean: update MAP with data residency bullet, firm vs estimated uplift note, and upload updated MAP to the Drive. (Due: Tue 3 Mar)
- Marissa: run the 48-hour peak token test and share results. (Due: Fri 6 Mar)
- Karthik: validate integration footprint and any VPC/network constraints; prepare infra runbook if needed. (Due: Fri 6 Mar)
- Darren: provide procurement checklist feedback and target PO date. (Due: Fri 13 Mar)

Attachments: Orchid_MAP_Q2_renewal.xlsx (updated), usage-summary-feb2026.pdf, procurement-worksheet.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ORCH-42

If there are no objections I’ll update the MAP with the data-residency checkbox and an uplift note saying: "Uplift estimate provided here is a preliminary pricing band; firm quote will follow the staging test and final usage projection, expected by 2026-03-13."

Thanks again — looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow.

Sean
